BiblicalUsage: Nophah is a place in Moab, named once in the song of the conquest: Heshbon is perished even unto Dibon, and the waste reaches even unto Nophah, which reaches unto Medeba. It is the far edge of the ruin.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that the song measures the ruin town by town: Nophah is where the wasting stops, at the border of Medeba.
